candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s), causing order and checkout to return 502; gateway checkout shows 502s at ~2s and p95 ~2425ms.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment transport ReadTimeout but no payment-side latency metrics; root cause within payment is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with ~2s durations. Traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout, propagating to order and checkout 502s, while inventory/redis succeed. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and logs to confirm payment-side slowness as the timeout source
